GpuAllocationMode.description:
Allocation mode selected by the Resource GPU catalog.

Callers submit only a catalog class and count. The mode is resolved from the
active catalog entry and is never accepted as an untrusted request override.

Revision.description: Monotonic aggregate revision. Zero is never a persisted revision.

description: Versioned GPU capacity catalog entry owned by Resource Service.

allocationBinding.description: Opaque provider mapping resolved by the selected capacity provider.
